# Readdy

> > Readdy is an AI-powered no-code website builder that enables instant website creation from prompts with drag-and-drop editing, integrations, and ecommerce capabilities.

Readdy combines conversational AI with visual design tools to help entrepreneurs and businesses build professional websites without coding. The platform integrates with popular services like Shopify, Figma, Stripe, and Supabase, offering templates, domain management, and an AI Agent for customer engagement.
